title: Prompting, RAG, fine-tuning or continued pre-training: cheapest first

questions.ask: Can clear instructions, few-shot examples and a defined output format get there?
Must answers come from your own documents or from information that changes?
questions.yes: RAG, for example Bedrock Knowledge Bases

questions.ask: Must the model learn a style, format or specialised task that prompting cannot reach?

otherwise: Continued pre-training on large amounts of unlabelled domain text
caption: Work down in order of cost and effort; the first yes is the answer, and data that changes belongs in RAG.
